Path to target score
What went wrong
1 · Knowledge
2 · Efficiency

Right answers that cost more time than they should have. Measured against a fixed target, not ’s own average — so being evenly slow still shows up.

3 · Pacing

One module at a time — the running total of time spent against the target pace for these questions. The target deliberately adds up to less than the module clock: that gap is the reserve, there to be spent on the questions that run long and on the review pass at the end. So tracking the target and finishing a few minutes early is the plan working — finishing far early means the reserve was never used.

Diagnostic Break

Take a breather — resume whenever you're ready. On the real test, you'd wait out the full clock, so use this time the way you would then.

Take a Break: Do Not Close Your Device

When you're ready, tap Resume Testing to start the next section.

Follow these rules during the break:

  1. Do not disturb anyone else who's still testing.
  2. Do not exit the app or close your device.
  3. Do not access your phone, notes, or the internet.
  4. Do not eat or drink near any testing device.
